biotools.summary: RareLink is an open-source framework built on REDCap that enables interoperability for rare disease data by linking international registries to HL7 FHIR R4 and GA4GH Phenopackets. The framework facilitates standardized data exchange and supports global scalability for equitable rare disease research.
